title: Data Science & Machine Learning
description: Analytical pipelines have been developed to extract insight from complex, large-scale datasets. Emphasis has been placed on clean evaluation, structured experimentation, and interpretability across a wide range of real-world problems.

title: LLMs & Agentic Systems
description: Intelligent systems have been designed by combining language models with retrieval and reasoning capabilities. Special focus has been given to agent workflows, autonomous decision-making, and safe real-world deployment.

title: Backend & Data Platforms
description: Scalable platforms have been architected to support real-time data flow, secure access, and operational reliability. Infrastructures have been optimized for both analytical workloads and production deployment.

title: Research & Mentorship
description: Technical knowledge has been transferred through teaching, publishing, and applied research. Teams and individuals have been mentored with a focus on clarity, creativity, and long-term growth.
